description: Registered senior citizens can receive the City's birthday cash gift and other programs for the elderly.
steps: Contact or visit the Office for Senior Citizens Affairs (OSCA), Ground floor, Ricardo Papa Bldg., Taguig City Hall, Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

sources.name: City of Taguig – Senior Citizens and Veterans

service: Birthday Cash Gift for Senior Citizens
description: Under City Ordinance No. 25, series of 2017, registered senior citizens receive a birthday cash gift of Php 3,000 to Php 10,000 based on their age. Centenarians receive a separate Php 100,000 cash gift from the City.
steps: Centenarians (100 and above): Php 100,000 every year

sources.name: City of Taguig – Senior Citizens and Veterans

service: Register as a Person With Disability (PWD ID)
description: The Persons With Disabilities Affairs Office (PDAO) handles PWD registration and PWD ID application, processing and issuance. Registered PWDs receive a Php 1,000 birthday cash gift (City Ordinance No. 18, series of 2017), and those aged 0–59 receive Special Needs Assistance of Php 1,000 every July and every December (Ordinance No. 194).
steps: Visit PDAO at the Ground Floor, Taguig Disability Resource and Development Center (TDRDC), Ipil-ipil St. corner 9th St., Barangay North Signal, Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

sources.name: City of Taguig – Persons With Disabilities

description: Registered solo parents can get medical assistance, educational benefits, livelihood support, free counseling, flexible work schedules, skills training, career coaching and mentoring, and basic life support training.
steps: Contact or visit the City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO), Ground floor, Ricardo Papa Bldg., Taguig City Hall, Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

description: A Php 20,000 cash grant to the family of the deceased to help with burial expenses.
steps: Contact or visit the City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO), Ground floor, Ricardo Papa Bldg., Taguig City Hall, Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

service: Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS)
description: In partnership with the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD), the AICS program helps people in crisis situations. For more information, visit the City Social Welfare and Development Office's official Facebook page.
steps: Cash assistance for other support services
